# CoinMarketCap

> CoinMarketCap provides real-time cryptocurrency prices, charts, rankings, market capitalization data, and research tools for digital assets.

CoinMarketCap tracks thousands of cryptocurrencies, exchanges, sectors, and on-chain market segments. It offers live market data, historical charts, token and exchange profiles, portfolio tools, educational content, and developer access to crypto market data APIs.

## Core Market Data
- [Cryptocurrency Prices, Charts And Market Capitalizations](https://coinmarketcap.com/): Main market overview for cryptocurrencies ranked by market capitalization, price, volume, and circulating supply.
- [Today’s Cryptocurrency Prices by Market Cap](https://coinmarketcap.com/all/views/all/): Full listing of tracked cryptocurrencies with market data across the entire catalog.
- [Global Cryptocurrency Charts](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/): Market-wide charts for total market cap, dominance, volumes, and other aggregate indicators.
- [Historical Snapshots](https://coinmarketcap.com/historical/): Archived market snapshots showing rankings and prices on past dates.
- [Top Crypto Gainers and Losers](https://coinmarketcap.com/gainers-losers/): Daily leaderboard of strongest and weakest price performers across tracked assets.
- [Trending Cryptocurrencies](https://coinmarketcap.com/trending-cryptocurrencies/): Assets currently trending on CoinMarketCap based on platform activity and interest.
- [Recently Added Cryptocurrencies](https://coinmarketcap.com/new/): Newly listed cryptocurrencies and tokens added to CoinMarketCap tracking.
- [Categories](https://coinmarketcap.com/cryptocurrency-category/): Crypto sectors and categories grouped by theme, performance, and market capitalization.

## Charts and Market Indicators
- [Spot Market Charts](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/spot-market/): Aggregate spot trading charts covering exchange activity, volume, and market structure.
- [Bitcoin Dominance Chart](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/bitcoin-dominance/): Tracks Bitcoin’s share of the total cryptocurrency market capitalization over time.
- [Altcoin Season Index](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/altcoin-season-index/): Indicator showing whether altcoins are outperforming Bitcoin across the market.
- [Fear and Greed Index](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/fear-and-greed-index/): Market sentiment indicator summarizing current crypto fear or greed conditions.
- [Total Crypto Market Cap Chart](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/total-crypto-market-cap/): Historical chart of aggregate cryptocurrency market capitalization.
- [Total Value Locked by Chain](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/tvl/): Visualizes total value locked trends across blockchain ecosystems.
- [Bitcoin Treasuries](https://coinmarketcap.com/charts/bitcoin-treasuries/): Tracks public company and institutional Bitcoin treasury holdings.

## Cryptocurrencies and Tokens
- [Bitcoin](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bitcoin/): Asset page with Bitcoin price, chart, market cap, supply, and related market data.
- [Ethereum](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/ethereum/): Asset page with Ethereum pricing, chart history, market cap, and token metrics.
- [Tether USDt](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/tether/): Stablecoin profile with market cap, supply, exchange listings, and historical chart data.
- [BNB](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/bnb/): Token page with BNB price, market data, and exchange market listings.
- [Solana](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/solana/): Asset profile with Solana price chart, market cap, and ecosystem links.
- [XRP](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/xrp/): XRP market page with live price, historical chart, and circulating supply data.
- [Dogecoin](https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/dogecoin/): Dogecoin profile with market statistics, chart, and trading market listings.
- [Memecoins Category](https://coinmarketcap.com/view/memes/): Category view for meme-themed cryptocurrencies ranked by market capitalization.

## Exchanges and Trading Data
- [Cryptocurrency Exchanges](https://coinmarketcap.com/rankings/exchanges/): Rankings for centralized crypto exchanges by traffic, liquidity, and trading volumes.
- [DEX Rankings](https://coinmarketcap.com/rankings/exchanges/dex/): Decentralized exchange rankings with volume and market share metrics.
- [Derivatives Exchanges](https://coinmarketcap.com/rankings/exchanges/derivatives/): Rankings for derivatives exchanges based on futures and perpetual trading activity.
- [Spot Exchanges Heatmap](https://coinmarketcap.com/rankings/exchanges/): Exchange comparison view for major spot trading venues.
- [Binance Exchange Profile](https://coinmarketcap.com/exchanges/binance/): Exchange page with supported markets, volumes, reserves, and confidence metrics.
- [Coinbase Exchange Profile](https://coinmarketcap.com/exchanges/coinbase-exchange/): Exchange profile with market listings, liquidity, and trading volume data.
- [DEXScan](https://coinmarketcap.com/dexscan/): DEX market explorer for on-chain trading pairs, tokens, and decentralized exchange activity.

## On-Chain, DeFi, and Ecosystems
- [Chain Ranking](https://coinmarketcap.com/chain-ranking/): Blockchains ranked by total value locked and ecosystem activity.
- [Yield](https://coinmarketcap.com/yield/): CeFi, DeFi, and stablecoin yield rates across supported platforms and assets.
- [Token Unlocks](https://coinmarketcap.com/token-unlock/): Upcoming and historical token unlock schedules with supply impact context.
- [Airdrops](https://coinmarketcap.com/airdrop/): Token airdrop directory with campaign details and participation information.
- [NFT Collections](https://coinmarketcap.com/nft/): NFT market section covering collections, floor prices, and trading activity.
- [Real World Assets](https://coinmarketcap.com/view/real-world-assets/): Category view for tokenized real-world asset projects and market performance.
- [Layer 1 Category](https://coinmarketcap.com/view/layer-1/): Category page for Layer 1 blockchain projects and comparative market data.
- [DeFi Category](https://coinmarketcap.com/view/defi/): Category page for decentralized finance tokens ranked by market capitalization.

## Research, News, and Community
- [CMC News](https://coinmarketcap.com/academy/categories/news): News coverage focused on cryptocurrency markets, projects, regulation, and industry developments.
- [CoinMarketCap Academy](https://coinmarketcap.com/academy/): Educational hub with explainers, guides, glossaries, and market commentary.
- [Guides](https://coinmarketcap.com/academy/categories/guides): Step-by-step educational content for crypto concepts, investing, and platform usage.
- [Glossary](https://coinmarketcap.com/academy/glossary): Definitions for cryptocurrency, blockchain, trading, and DeFi terminology.
- [Research Articles](https://coinmarketcap.com/academy/categories/research): Longer-form analysis and research content on crypto markets and protocols.
- [Alexandria Articles](https://coinmarketcap.com/alexandria/): Editorial and educational content covering crypto basics and market topics.
- [Community](https://coinmarketcap.com/community/): Social and community area for discussions, updates, and user engagement.

## Products and Tools
- [Portfolio](https://coinmarketcap.com/portfolio-tracker/): Portfolio tracking tool for monitoring holdings, performance, and allocation changes.
- [Watchlist](https://coinmarketcap.com/watchlist/): Personalized watchlist for following selected cryptocurrencies and market movements.
- [Converter](https://coinmarketcap.com/converter/): Crypto price converter for comparing digital assets and fiat currencies.
- [Price Estimates](https://coinmarketcap.com/price-estimates/): Community-driven price prediction pages for tracked cryptocurrencies.
- [ICO Calendar](https://coinmarketcap.com/ico-calendar/): Calendar of token sales and fundraising events for upcoming crypto projects.
- [Events Calendar](https://coinmarketcap.com/events/): Schedule of crypto conferences, launches, and ecosystem events.
- [Learn and Earn](https://coinmarketcap.com/earn/): Educational reward campaigns that combine lessons with token incentives.
- [Diamond Rewards](https://coinmarketcap.com/diamonds/): Loyalty and rewards program for platform users completing activities.

## Developers and API
- [API Documentation](https://coinmarketcap.com/api/documentation/v1/): Reference documentation for CoinMarketCap’s cryptocurrency market data API.
- [API Overview](https://coinmarketcap.com/api/): Product overview for CoinMarketCap API plans, features, and access options.
- [API Best Practices](https://coinmarketcap.com/api/documentation/v1/#section/Best-Practices): Guidance for efficient and reliable use of CoinMarketCap API endpoints.
- [Cryptocurrency Listings Endpoint](https://coinmarketcap.com/api/documentation/v1/#operation/getV1CryptocurrencyListingsLatest): API endpoint for latest cryptocurrency listings and market data.
- [Quotes Latest Endpoint](https://coinmarketcap.com/api/documentation/v1/#operation/getV1CryptocurrencyQuotesLatest): API endpoint for latest quotes on one or more cryptocurrencies.
- [Exchange Listings Endpoint](https://coinmarketcap.com/api/documentation/v1/#operation/getV1ExchangeListingsLatest): API endpoint for latest exchange rankings and market statistics.
- [Global Metrics Endpoint](https://coinmarketcap.com/api/documentation/v1/#operation/getV1GlobalMetricsQuotesLatest): API endpoint for current global cryptocurrency market metrics.
- [DEX API Overview](https://coinmarketcap.com/api/documentation/dex/): Documentation for CoinMarketCap DEX and on-chain market data APIs.

## Company and Platform Information
- [About CoinMarketCap](https://coinmarketcap.com/about/): Overview of CoinMarketCap, its mission, history, and platform role in crypto markets.
- [Methodology](https://coinmarketcap.com/methodology/): Explains ranking, liquidity, market pair, and data quality methodologies used on the site.
- [Glossary of Metrics](https://coinmarketcap.com/alexandria/glossary): Reference glossary for common crypto and market data terminology.
- [Careers](https://coinmarketcap.com/careers/): Employment opportunities and company information for prospective team members.
- [Request Form](https://support.coinmarketcap.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Support request entry point for listings, corrections, and account issues.
- [Support Center](https://support.coinmarketcap.com/hc/en-us): Help center with articles about listings, products, and account support.
